decisions.reason: As a support add-on close to the firm’s core hosting business, it is easy to justify keeping, even though the limited public commitment means management could still remove it if uptake stays weak.
This tool builds directly on the firm’s platform, had its own page, and reflects in-house development investment, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to continue it.
Although the firm invested enough to create a product line and market it separately, its distance from the core hosting offer makes it harder to justify further commitment once results disappoint.
Because it is a flagship agency-hosting line tied to the firm’s stated direction and shown prominently on the home page, management is very unlikely to withdraw it soon.
